args.bug_report: Cart subtotal is wrong when the cart holds several different products. With 2 mugs ($12.50 each), 1 lamp ($39.99) and 3 pens ($1.00 each) the subtotal shows $64.99, but it should be $67.99.
args.root_cause: Off-by-one loop bound in Cart.subtotal (pyshop/cart.py:54): `for i in range(len(self.items) - 1)` iterates only items[0..n-2] and never adds the last line item's total. In the reported cart (mugs, lamp, pens added in that order) the pens line (3 x $1.00 = $3.00) is skipped, so subtotal = 25.00 + 39....

reasoning: The bug is an off-by-one in subtotal: range(len-1) skips the last line item, which matches the report (missing the $3.00 pens line, giving $64.99 instead of $67.99). The patch fixes the bound to range(len(items)), summing all lines. No side effects; other logic unchanged.
